I did not find much direct evidence of Sharif personally resolving major crises through durable institutional bargains beyond official statements and top-down interventions. The biggest gap is independent, on-the-record evidence about internal civil-military bargaining and how much of the repression or diplomacy was personally driven by Sharif versus inherited state machinery.","evidence":[{"title":"Joint Statement on 6th Round of Pakistan-UK Dialogue on Arms Control & Non-Proliferation","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://mofa.gov.pk/press-releases/6th-round-of-pakistan-uk-dialogue-on-arms-control-non-proliferation","summary":"Pakistan and the UK held a cordial arms-control/nonproliferation dialogue and pledged continued coordination in multilateral fora. That cuts against preserving neutral institutions as a durable base for rule.","question_ids":["8B.9"]},{"title":"X blocked on national-security grounds","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-04-17","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313","summary":"The government confirmed blocking X around the election period. That is weak evidence for durable, accountable regime management.","question_ids":["8B.9"]}]}
